<thought>We need to determine how many methyl (CH₃) groups are present in the unknown compound. The available tools can provide NMR spectra for the sample. By retrieving the ¹H NMR spectrum, we can look for signals in the typical methyl region (~0.8–1.2 ppm). Each distinct methyl group will give a separate signal (unless chemically equivalent). Counting these signals will give the number of CH₃ groups. We'll request the proton NMR spectrum for the sample.</thought>
